title: Table
overview: Rows and columns of comparable records. Caption, headers, one primary sort story.
apply_when: Comparable records they scan, sort, or compare cell by cell.
not_when: A layout grid of cards (content_card), a chart of relationships (chart), or a map.

vs.why: shape of a relationship, not cell lookup
teaser tiles, not a grid of cells

role.overview: Rows and columns of comparable records. Caption, headers, one primary sort story.
role.apply_when: Comparable records they scan, sort, or compare cell by cell.
role.not_when: A layout grid of cards (content_card), a chart, or a map.

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: A caption names the table; headers name columns (and rows when needed).
composition.not_when: A grid of divs with bold first row.

state.overview: One primary sort is active and named.
state.not_when: Arrows on every column with no current sort.

state.overview: Rows are in flight — prefer skeleton geometry over an empty table.
state.not_when: A spinner with no table shape (loading_indicator vs skeleton).

accessibility.overview: The table has a caption or equivalent name.
Header cells are headers (scope / markup), not just bold.
accessibility.not_when: First row is styled bold in divs.

accessibility.overview: The sorted column and direction are exposed.

keyboard.overview: Tab lands on interactive cells (links, buttons, inputs), not every TD.
If this is a grid widget, arrows move the cell. A static table does not invent a grid.
keyboard.not_when: Arrows trap them in a static table.
